Mapping application - architecture (baseline 03f2168)
|
|-- [M] MappingPage composes the editing workspace
|   |-- Injected services
|   |   |-- DiagramService: exposes create / revise / resolve / generate
|   |   |   |-- [O] Sole writer of immutable diagram content revisions
|   |   |   `-- [D] content + source evidence + base revision
|   |   |       `-- new revision + proven node correspondence
|   |   `-- CanvasHistoryService: context, checkpoint and navigation API
|   |       |-- [O] Owns editing contexts and their histories
|   |       |-- Retains checkpoints, revision bindings, baseline and head
|   |       `-- [D] document + view + correspondence -> bound checkpoint
|   |
|   `-- [O] CanvasWorkspace manages open documents
|       |-- [M] Exposes document lifecycle and persistence notifications
|       |-- [O] Creates, subscribes to and disposes CanvasSessions
|       |-- drafts[documentId]: identity, save baseline, presentation, session
|       |   `-- [O] CanvasSession retains MappingDocumentController
|       |       |-- [M] Exposes coordinated document and interaction stores
|       |       `-- [C] onCommit() -> notify workspace persistence
|       `-- [D] controllers[documentId] indexes session-retained controllers
|
|-- [M] MappingDocumentController coordinates one document
|   |-- [O] Retains the current editing state
|   |   |-- Semantic document: MappingGridDocument
|   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
|   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox; instances reference contentId
|   |   |   |   |   `-- containers retain nested GridBoxes
|   |   |   |   `-- contents[id]: Diagram
|   |   |   |       `-- ASCII, parsed structure, source mappings and evidence
|   |   |   `-- edges / jumps / sections
|   |   |-- Interaction state: MappingCanvasState
|   |   |   |-- selection.items[]: unified diagram and region membership
|   |   |   |-- diagramViews: per-diagram folding
|   |   |   |-- DisplayState: floating selections, projections, conversations, details
|   |   |   `-- MappingControls: active identities and owner selection surfaces
|   |   `-- Retains CanvasEditingContext attachment
|   |       `-- [O] Context lifetime belongs to CanvasHistoryService
|   |
|   |-- [M] Exposes editing operations
|   |   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|   |   |   |-- [C] Invoked by UI or agent bridge
|   |   |   |-- Validate and stage
|   |   |   |   |-- [D] expected + current version -> conflict check
|   |   |   |   `-- [D] document + interaction state -> staged state
|   |   |   |-- Apply operations
|   |   |   |   |-- [C] Content changes -> DiagramService.create / revise
|   |   |   |   |   `-- [D] new revision + node correspondence
|   |   |   |   `-- Instance / view changes -> boxes, edges, sections, views
|   |   |   |-- Derive consistent layout and presentation
|   |   |   |   |-- [D] ASCII dimensions + box hierarchy -> final cell bounds
|   |   |   |   |-- Anchor changed box; push colliding siblings
|   |   |   |   |-- [D] content changes + correspondence -> reconciled endpoints
|   |   |   |   `-- [D] grid bounds + placement policies -> floating pixel bounds
|   |   |   |       `-- Floating bounds never displace GridBoxes
|   |   |   `-- Commit and publish
|   |   |       |-- [C] CanvasHistoryService.append
|   |   |       |   `-- [D] document + view + correspondence -> checkpoint + version
|   |   |       `-- [C] Notify snapshot subscribers -> session -> workspace persistence
|   |   |-- commitDocument(...): commit document and layout edits
|   |   `-- updateCanvas(...) / select(...): pane, control and selection state
|   |       `-- Ordinary controls and measurements add no checkpoint
|   |
|   |-- [M] Exposes history navigation
|   |   |-- [C] undo / redo / reset -> CanvasHistoryService navigation
|   |   |   `-- [D] context + target checkpoint -> restored state
|   |   `-- [C] exportHistory / forkHistory -> exportContext / forkContext
|   |       `-- [O] Fork gets a distinct context retaining revision IDs
|   |
|   `-- [M] Exposes read models
|       |-- getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot
|       |   |-- [D] context -> contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
|       |   |-- [C] historyService.state(context) -> canUndo / canRedo
|       |   `-- document + canvas interaction state
|       |-- getCanvasSnapshot(): CanvasDocument; semantic canvas snapshot
|       |-- resolveDiagram(diagramId): DiagramView
|       |   `-- [D] diagram identity + current revision binding -> view
|       `-- nodes(): DisplayNode[]
|           |-- [D] document + presentation + geometry -> public registry
|           |   `-- Derived nodes; not a second authoritative document
|           |-- Common identity / read-time version / hierarchy / expansion
|           |-- Grid nodes: diagram or group, authoritative boxId, cell bounds
|           |   `-- diagram instance -> DiagramContent
|           `-- Floating nodes: placement policies -> pixel bounds
|               `-- SelectionRegion / ProjectedPane / ConversationPane / DetailPane
|
|-- [M] Agent access adapts external requests to document operations
|   `-- [C] MCP -> HTTP backend -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec
|       |-- Synchronous canvas / nodes / edges API
|       `-- [C] Live requests -> CanvasSessionBridge -> useAgentCanvasBridge
|           `-- Attached session's controller: read models or applyUpdate(...)
|
`-- [M] Persistence retains and restores workspace state
    |-- Incremental autosave: WorkspacePersistence
    |   |-- [C] workspace.onPersist(documentIds): session commits identify changes
    |   |-- [C] Also observes SourcePaneViewState changes
    |   `-- [C] controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) -> RecordStorage.batch(changes)
    |       `-- [D] retained records + cursor -> incremental changes
    |-- WorkspaceStorage
    |   |-- [O] Owns RecordStorage: cached records + pending writes
    |   `-- [O] Owns workspaceStorage.worker: encode, transport and restore records
    `-- Explicit export: capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot
        |-- [D] workspace identity + active document + transfers
        |-- [D] each open document -> MappingDocumentSnapshot
        |   `-- identity, saved baselines, revisionId, hidden, document, state, viewport
        `-- [C] controller.exportHistory() -> portable revision tables and bindings

[M] modular structure | [O] ownership | [C] call flow | [D] data dependency
